unit.why: The division describes how the Lublin rebbe's Torah at the Sabbath table depended on the holy influx from heaven at that moment, and why he could not fully record it in writing during the week. It cites Zikhron Zot and ends with an editorial lead-in to his sayings, with no narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: the closing sentence introduces the sayings that follow in the next divisions
